key_insight: A graph neural network can learn the energy shift between heterogeneous DFT methods and align legacy PBE formation energies to r2SCAN-like accuracy.
engineering_relevance: This enables large multi-source materials datasets to be merged more reliably for phase stability, battery, and reaction-property prediction.
method: Train on 380,190 PBE-r2SCAN paired structures from MatPES
Predict cross-functional energy residuals with a structure-aware GPTFF graph neural network
Use the learned correction to convert PBE energies to r2SCAN-level values
evidence_signal: On the MatPES benchmark, the model reduces conversion error to 14.3 meV/atom MAE, improving over CHGNet at 18.2 meV/atom.
watch_item: The correction is only as reliable as the functional pairing and structural coverage seen during training, so extrapolation to unseen DFT setups may need revalidation.
paper_title: Aligning Heterogeneous DFT Datasets: A Graph Neural Network Approach to Cross-Functional Formation Energies
